candidate.answerReason: Horizontal and vertical coordinate separations form perpendicular legs, and the distance is the hypotenuse. The Pythagorean theorem therefore gives the distance formula, so B is correct.

methods.label: Identify the right-triangle relationship
methods.explanation: The differences in the x-coordinates and y-coordinates are the legs of a right triangle, and the distance is the hypotenuse.
methods.levelReason: Uses elementary coordinate geometry and the Pythagorean theorem.
